summary: Describes Dead Peer Detection (DPD), a method used by a number of vendors to detect a dead IKE peer. It uses IPsec traffic patterns to minimize the IKE messages needed to confirm liveness, so a router can fail over and reclaim lost resources. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If you are chatting and your friend goes quiet, you check they are still there. This lets secure tunnel gear check on its partner only when needed, and give up if nobody answers.

questions: how to detect a dead ipsec peer
